title: wait for N ns inside a procedure body — Phase 3 regression fence
sourceUrl: internal: STATUS.md §1 — waits inside procedure bodies (Phase 3)
problemDescription: A process calls a procedure `step_state` whose body waits for 20 ns then toggles a signal formal. Pre-Phase-3, ProcedureCallStatement.ExecuteAsync only walked `report` and `<=` tokens in def.BodyRaw — every other token (including `wait`) was silently dropped, so the caller ran through the procedure body in zero time and `q` slammed to its post-wait value at t=0. Fix: ResolveBoundBody rebuilds the body per call with formal→actual textual substitution, pushes a ProcedureFrame on the Process.Frames stack, and RunProcedureFromFrameAsync yields the entire process at the WaitForStatement inside the procedure. Q should step at 20/40/60/80/100/120 ns; pre-fix Kmila showed only the first transition at t=0.
